quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Incredible! Incredible! How did you hook a fish that quickly... That Linebreaker you defeated looks pretty powerful, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Defeated a... a Linebreaker? Paimon doesn't really get what you're saying...

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: *ahem* The experts at the fishing association say that fishing is like dueling! Fishers use their rods, line, and bait as weapons, and they wrestle against the might of the fish that swim beneath the waves, those great lunkers called Linebreakers! Hence, Linebreaking for short!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Calling it that sounds really strange... It's just fishing, right? There's nothing too special about it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Unless we're talking about, like... those super massive fish? The ones that can't possibly be landed?

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: No, no! Sorry for making you feel so confused. It must be a problem with the way I explained it. Yes, the problem lies with me!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Even though I am the director of the Fontaine Fishing Association, I've never managed to catch even a single fish... So when I watched you hook one without any difficulty at all, I was especially shocked!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Director? That sounds like a pretty important position!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But you said you've never caught a fish before. Then how did you manage to become the director?

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Oh, that has nothing to do with fishing itself. It's just that everyone holds the equipment I provide in high regard.

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: I used to be an ordinary clerk at the Fontaine Research Institute. I was in charge of purchasing equipment and negotiating prices with vendors... But most of the time, I was just waiting for responses from them.

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: All I could do was wander around the streets in search of something to do while waiting for them to get back to me. It felt like I was wasting my life, and I just couldn't take it anymore!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wasting your life... and you couldn't take it? You don't have to do anything, and people will still think you're hard at work! Why would you be upset about that? Paimon doesn't get it...

choices.text: I wouldn't mind a job like that...

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Thankfully, I met my new friends at the Fishing Association and they introduced me to the fun of fishing! After getting hooked on this hobby, my life took on a whole new direction!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: To repay them, I provided them with lots of equipment sitting around unused by the Institute. Using the kits I gave them, the members of the association started getting quite a few more bites on their hooks!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: They credited me for all their newfound success. Since I was familiar with the process of interacting with vendors and had an excess of free time, everyone elected me as director...

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: But even though I'm now partially in charge of the Fishing Association, I've still never caught any fish... Not even a fry as big as my finger. I can't help but feel like I'm not doing my job!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe... you were just super unlucky? Maybe the fish are like you, wandering off for a swim instead of doing their jobs and sticking around near the hook?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we caught some fish just now, which means the fishes are back at their posts and doing their jobs! Why don't you give it another shot right now?

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: That... sounds like a good idea! I'll give it another shot!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Delaroche concentrates wholeheartedly on fishing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks that Delaroche is pretty honest! She even told us stuff like how she's skipping out on work and fishing on the job without any hesitation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But, now that Paimon thinks about it, is it really possible for someone to fish for months and never get a bite? Just what's going on here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If Delaroche doesn't manage to catch a fish and loses her confidence, or if people start doubting her and she gets replaced as the director of the Fishing Association, maybe the new person won't be nearly as easy to get along with...

choices.text: It's important that the director has a good personality!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you agree with Paimon! Then we should help her and make sure she catches at least one fish and doesn't give up on the job...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Nothing looks wrong with Delaroche's fishing pole, and she's really focused and not fidgeting at all...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Maybe the problem's <color=#00E1FFFF>underwater</color>? Something about her bait? Let's check out the <color=#00E1FFFF>hook</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>bait</color> she's using!)

choices.text: Whoa, you're actually anticipating potential risks!
I'd like to get paid to loaf around...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the "Active Odor Imitating Bait"...

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Ah! This piece of kit, well, if you really want to talk about it, there's a ton of details. I already went over some of the advantages with you just now.

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: As for its disadvantages... It's too expensive and too time-consuming to make. The inside is full of these... intricate mechanisms. I heard it's comparable to a watch!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: On my current salary, I can't afford to purchase more than a few pieces of bait like this, so my next goal will be to reduce its costs...

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Of course, I'll need to rely on my friends at the institute for this. I... I can stand by their side, cheering them on!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? Delaroche's hook doesn't have any bait on it at all... Even a layman knows that fishing requires bait. How can you catch a fish with just an empty hook?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If we ask Delaroche directly, it might seem like we're insulting her intelligence...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It might be a bit too rude!

choices.text: Let's talk about bait in general first...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Good idea! Let's try to be more tactful this time. Let's think of it as practice for dealing with any well-intentioned but very confused people we might run into in the future!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we already dove down here to check her hook, leaving it completely bare like this is kind of a shame... Maybe there's something more we can do?

choices.text: Let's put a fish on it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, that's pretty direct!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hm... It does sound like a good idea though. As long as it can cheer Delaroche up and help her understand the importance of bait, then all will be well!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's do it!

choices.text: Let's hold a fish's head down until it bites the hook!
Let's start by asking her about the type of bait she likes...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you catch a fish? Congratulations!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Ah! I thought you two left. Thankfully, you didn't miss out on this momentous moment! I have incredibly wonderful news for you!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Just now, I finally... finally! Finally caught a huge fish! This fish's physique and weight are beyond compare. My friends at the association will be agog when they see it!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: And it's all thanks to your advice. As of today, I have finally ceased to be fishless... I must sincerely express my deepest gratitude to you both!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... congratulations! We just wanna ask, why don't you usually use bait... Uh, Paimon means, what is your favorite kind of bait to use?

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Hm? Why are you suddenly asking about that? I'm not that proficient with bait types, really...

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: I only heard an older angler say: "The more the bait diffuses, the more fish it can attract." So, I supplemented the most popular bait formulas with a substance that dissolves more easily in the water...

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Hold on, does this mean that overly soft bait will lose out to Linebreakers in battle... Is that why I never managed to catch any fish before?

choices.text: It didn't "lose" to the fish...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! So it's not that she didn't use bait, but the bait she used completely disintegrated? If it just turned into soup in the water... then why would the fish ever bite the hook!?

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: I think I understand... I finally understand! You two have granted me the essential epiphany! Please... accept my sincerest thanks!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Of course, this meager reward isn't enough. Once I become a master angler renowned throughout Fontaine, you will be known as my distinguished mentors. Such a title will be priceless!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Next, I'm going to alter the composition of my bait. I'll make it sturdier, and then I'll beat the strongest of the Linebreakers with but a few tugs!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's not exactly how it's supposed to work, but at least Delaroche knows not to use bait that easily dissolves! Things turned out okay, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon hopes everything will go as smoothly as Delaroche imagines!

choices.text: It's just completely dissolved...

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche's Fish Hook
dialogues.text: What kind of bait should be placed on the hook?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you had much luck recently?

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Whoa! You two finally showed up again!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: I hope your arrival heralds the revival of my fishing career once again...

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: No, no! I must execute the plan and use my own strength to overcome any problems. I can't just rely on other people to do the thinking all the time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? What's wrong? Why are you panicking?

choices.text: Could it be that you ran into trouble again?

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: I'm embarrassed to say...

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Ever since you two inspired me, I've completely changed how I think about making bait. I increased the strength, and now it can't possibly be destroyed when I'm scuffling against a Linebreaker!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: But even so, I still can't catch a single fish, much less relive the glory I felt that day...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Uh, d—don't worry! The fish you caught then was... a rare specimen! You can't catch another one like that twice in a short time... right, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Yep yep yep!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Of course, I won't give up that easily! I should look on the bright side. My current situation is still far better when compared to my "fishless" phase!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Recently, I bought a bunch of different bait from my friends at the Fishing Association and plan to test their effects one after another... I also need to investigate rod, hook, and line combinations!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: I should consider your appearance as a sign and redouble my efforts, and keep testing all kinds of new combinations...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Delaroche takes up her rod once more, meticulously examines her bait, and dedicates all her focus on fishing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Delaroche is pretty motivated... She managed to psyche herself up before we even said anything and didn't seem discouraged at all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: From what she said though, it sounds like her primary focus is on making sure the bait isn't destroyed by the Linebreakers...

choices.text: Sounds like the problem is with her bait again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks so too! Anyway, shall we dive underwater and help her out again?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... if we keep attaching fish to her hook, it feels like we're treating her like a child and just trying to keep her happy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's try switching out her bait this time. That way, at least the act of catching the fish will belong to her!

choices.text: If the bait's too hard, the fish can't bite into it.
I shall bear witness to the truth of the statement!
You still can't catch any fish?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you tried any new bait recently?

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Hahaha! My "Gods of Victorious Linebreaking"! You're right on time! Soon, you shall witness the moment when I surpass myself and make history!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Delaroche sure is confident today... Seems like fishing has been going well for her!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: That's right! I wish to speak with you about a miracle I experienced. As I was testing my bait before, I found a new type of bait of unknown provenance, and I know not which expert bait-maker created it...

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Upon being cast into the water, it can immediately attract all the nearby fish! I heard it uses advanced alchemy, so even if you know the formula, an ordinary person can't replicate the effects!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: I'm guessing it's you two that blessed me with the luck to meet such a master bait-maker! This superb, preeminent, and all-supreme master is unmatched and unequalled in their generosity leaving me such bait!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! This superb, preeminent... uh, all-supreme master sounds really nice!

choices.text: Haha! Who's this kind benefactor?

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: At this point, I cannot let the efforts of this benefactor go to waste! They must have left the bait to inspire me, not to give me a completed product for me to copy and rely on.

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: I'll only be able to catch a few paltry fish if the bait only lasts for a moment or two, but by understanding the principles underlying the effectiveness of the bait, I will be able to hook countless monster-sized fish!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: So, I strained my brain to the fullest and bought a few special gifts before inviting a few researcher friends of mine over to help create the "Active Odor Imitating Bait"...

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: This device can analyze the odors given off by dissolving bait and will use other ingredients to imitate the effects! Using this, I can become the greatest angler in all of Fontaine!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, you need to slow down a bit! Going from someone who just made a new kind of bait to being the greatest fisher in Fontaine... You seemed to have skipped over a bunch of steps in between!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: The details are unimportant! After receiving your encouragement, my motivation has ascended far beyond what was once possible. If I can't rise to the top in one go, that would be simply unacceptable!

choices.text: That kind of confidence is a bit excessive...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Delaroche... she's gone from one extreme to the other!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, didn't you say you wanted to use that new bait to break your own records? But it looks like... you aren't fishing at all?

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: There lies the rub. Not long ago, I hooked a truly gargantuan fish. But it managed to bite the "Active Odor Imitating Bait" clean off the hook.

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: As such, I have prepared a divesuit to descend into the waters and retrieve my bait! Though I have never dived before, I believe that as long as I follow the instruction manual, I should be fine!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: It's a pity, but I fear I'll have to ask you two to wait a moment...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, whoa, hold on! If you've never dived before, don't just jump in headfirst! If you get lost underwater or your divesuit malfunctions... Not even the archons or adepti can save you!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: But if I don't retrieve my "Active Odor Imitating Bait," all the effort I made will have been in vain! And hiring a professional diver costs far too much. I have to do something...

choices.text: It's just a piece of bait.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yeah! Paimon and {NICKNAME} are pretty good at getting around underwater. Let us help, we'll be done in a flash!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: I... I don't know what to say! I shall prostrate myself before you! All the way down on the ground!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Ah... I seem to have been standing here too long... My hips are numb and my legs are cramping... I can't even kneel...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks she might be the first person we've met that's this... obsessed with fishing, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, if that bait is as good as Delaroche says, she might actually become a legendary angler after all...

choices.text: We'll get it for you, just watch.
To the point it's a bit disquieting...
I don't think it's anything special!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you land another one?

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: You two! You two are my "Gods of Victorious Linebreaking"!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Every time you show up, it's like I'm imbued with some kind of power, and just reel these Linebreakers right up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hm! We were just mentors last time, and now, we're gods... This is getting ridiculous!

choices.text: Then you should thank us!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Aaaah! I almost forgot. I am so sorry! I'll go to the bank later and see how much savings I have...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Savings! That sounds pretty hefty...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Agh! No, wait! {NICKNAME} is probably just joking!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Asking for money while claiming to be a god is what scammers do!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This time... Uh... Well, from now on, every time you catch a fish, you must believe that you can defeat even the strongest of Linebreakers with just your... uh, what's it called?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right! With your determination and dedication to fishing!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Of course, it's also important to choose the right bait... Maybe there are different types of bait that are even more effective than the ones you've been using, and might help you hook even bigger fishes. You should try using more types of bait!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well said, Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If you want to thank us, you don't need to clean out your savings. You just need to reasonably express your gratitude.

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: You two! You're positively glowing right now!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: I've never been so encouraged by someone else before!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: But please don't be so modest with me! What's a bit of Mora compared to all the inspiration you gave me? It is but the paltriest expression of my gratitude!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: I will remember your teachings, and my efforts will be unceasing! Henceforth, I shall not waste a single second more!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: As for the bait, I thank you both for your reminders! I will keep trying new combinations! And soon, you will see... a confident and mighty expert angler!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Delaroche goes back to fishing with renewed focus...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Delaroche still ended up giving us some Mora... It's not a lot, but she sure is sincere!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How about we just put some normal bait in her luggage? When she starts experimenting with bait later, she'll find that ours is the most effective and stop using the wrong stuff!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You place effective yet easy-to-make bait into Delaroche's luggage...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Perfect! This way, Delaroche will always be able to hook the biggest of fish in the future!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And our labors will finally come to an end!

choices.text: Remember to make offerings to your new gods!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're back!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: How did it go? Did you find my "Active Odor Imitating Bait"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's right here, Delaroche, hold onto it! But don't get too excited just yet. There's something very important we have to tell you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #(Agh. {NICKNAME}, do we want to speak to her slowly and rationally or... exaggerate a little? Y'know, scare her and emphasize how dangerous this piece of bait is?)

choices.text: Let's explain patiently and rationally.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Alright! Then let's emphasize how, uh... most of the fish will be scared off if monsters appear! Not being able to catch any fish should unnerve Delaroche enough to stop using that dangerous bait!)

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You and Paimon describe the incident that just happened underwater to Delaroche, stressing how the "Active Odor Imitating Bait" will attract aquatic monsters and threaten the fishing spot...\nThough you don't know much about the ecological relations between aquatic monsters and regular fish, you've met your share of scholars, and find yourself more than capable of imitating their manner of speaking...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You artfully describe how some aquatic monsters will completely clear all fish from an area just by passing through those waters, as they are known to frequently emit an "indescribable screech." Even fish not regularly predated by the monsters will be unable to endure such a disturbance, and will thus scatter in terror...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Your descriptions are so vivid, they render Delaroche dumbstruck. Facing the waters with a grave expression, she spends a long moment in silent rumination before shifting her attention back to the present...

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: So that means that the "Active Odor Imitating Bait" can disturb an entire section of the underwater ecology. I never thought it could have such an enormous impact...

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Thank you for your advice! I absolutely shouldn't use the "Active Odor Imitating Bait" so crudely and irresponsibly, or risk damaging underwater habitats...

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: I should treat it as a tool, and study the bait I found last time! Using the imitated scents as a starting point, I should be able to better analyze the composition of bait like that...

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Now that I think about it, perhaps I can use this method to learn about making bait. If I understand the principles behind bait-making, I'll be able to improve by leaps and bounds!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Haha! When the time comes, I'll even be able to help the others in the Fishing Association make superior bait, and help everyone catch some whopping big fish!

choices.text: That's a nice thought!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! That sounds a lot more useful than what you were doing before. We'll all sleep easier knowing that Delaroche isn't recklessly using bait like that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Scrambling around like that is so tiring, especially since Paimon was nervous the whole time...

choices.text: Yeah, I'm exhausted!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: I must thank you both again, my gratitude is boundless!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Though I spent most of my budget creating the "Active Odor Imitating Bait," the Mora and gifts I promised you... I actually prepared them in advance. Please accept them as my token of thanks!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No need to be so serious! As long as you are fishing safely and happily, then our effort hasn't been in vain.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In the future, we'll often come around and fish. Remember to show us all your amazing accomplishments then!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Of course, I never idly boast!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Thanks to you two, I've found the true path to becoming the ultimate angler! Not only that, I must... spread the fame of the "Gods of Victorious Linebreaking" across all of Fontaine!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: When next we meet, maybe I'll have created a fantastic new kind of bait! I'll give it to you for free, no matter how much you need!

choices.text: Poor us!
You have a promising future!
Let's scare her!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Hmm. That could work too. Delaroche doesn't seem to realize just how dangerous some things are, after all... Maybe if we don't make things sound super scary, she won't take these matters seriously, and will just end up hurting herself!)

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You and Paimon describe the incident that just happened underwater to Delaroche, stressing how dangerous the monsters drawn by the "Active Odor Imitating Bait" are...\nTo better illustrate to Delaroche how helpless an ordinary person would be when faced with an aquatic monster, you and Paimon begin a lively performance to aid her conceptualization...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You play a large monster while Paimon plays a smaller one. You begin a game of catch using a Sunsettia, tossing it back and forth as it becomes more and more mangled. Said Sunsettia symbolizes an ordinary person.\nThus, it dawns on Delaroche: "Though the difference in size may not be so great, this is what happens when an ordinary person encounters an aquatic monster. A human will be completely helpless, and become a mere plaything!"

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After the demonstration, Paimon promptly eats the Sunsettia...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nom... Nom... Anyway! People who get nabbed by aquatic monsters be helpless, just like that! Even if they don't get eaten, they're going to be pretty miserable!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: I never thought the effects of the "Active Odor Imitating Bait" would be so extreme. I didn't think it would attract anything that couldn't be caught and eaten...

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Your feedback has been crucial! I'll keep the maximum efficacy of the "Active Odor Imitating Bait" low and maintain it at a level that can attract Linebreakers, but nothing out of the ordinary...

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: In terms of safety precautions, I'll also need to prepare a weapon I'm familiar with and prepare to... repel any aquatic monsters that leap above the surface, and perhaps even cut the line if things are untenable!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's good! Delaroche finally knows how serious things are and her enthusiasm hasn't been curbed... We can relax now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Scrambling around like that is so tiring, especially since Paimon was nervous the whole time...

choices.text: Yeah, I'm exhausted!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: I must thank you both again, my gratitude is boundless!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Though I spent most of my budget creating the "Active Odor Imitating Bait," the Mora and gifts I promised you... I actually prepared them in advance. Please accept them as my token of thanks!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No need to be so serious! As long as you are fishing safely and happily, then our effort hasn't been in vain.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In the future, we'll often come around and fish. Remember to show us all your amazing accomplishments then!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Of course, I never idly boast!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: Thanks to you two, I will soon become the ultimate angler! And then, I will spread the fame of the "Gods of Victorious Linebreaking" across all of Fontaine!

response.speaker: Delaroche
response.text: If I really... if I really manage to knock out some strange manner of "seafood" and reel it in, maybe I can gift it to you as a souvenir. I hope you won't mind such a gift!

choices.text: Poor us!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry. Your tide will come in...

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Alright! I can stay calm! Thanks for your encouragement!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: All that time... I held on despite never catching a single fish. What's a few more hours compared to that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Keep going! Take down that Linebreaker!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Okay! I won't let you down!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Thanks to your reminders last time, I managed to find the heart of the problem! Now, I urgently need to create much sturdier bait!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: I'll need to find more references and prepare enough high-quality ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Remember to try many more different types of bait!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Of course! I could never ignore any advice bestowed upon me by the "Gods of Victorious Linebreaking"!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: After finding effective bait, I must also research its key ingredients and understand the underlying principles behind it...

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Yes. I must keep trying, keep striving!

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche's Fish Hook
dialogues.text: What kind of fish should be put on the hook?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Regarding the strength of the bait...

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: That's a good question! Before, I noticed that most bait includes flour, but no matter how I adjusted the formula, it just wasn't hard enough.

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: So this time, I added mineral powder to the mix along with construction materials for building walls.

dialogues.speaker: Delaroche
dialogues.text: Let's see those Linebreakers try to shatter stone, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Eek! Monsters! Could it be that the bait drew them to this area... Get rid of them quick, {NICKNAME}!
